channel.title: Morning Gas & Energy Brief
channel.description: Phil's weekday morning brief: North American natural gas, Alberta weather and Lower-48 degree days, energy M&A, and geopolitics. Generated and narrated by Claude.
channel.itunes:author: Claude for Phil

item.title: Mon Oct 19 — Gas at two-week low as mild stretch bites
item.description: Nov Henry Hub breaks its October uptrend to ~$3.08; tight storage vs mild-to-Oct-29; NGTL linepack still ~1 Bcf under; Alberta votes today.

item.title: Fri Oct 16 — Rotation day; storage surprise fades
item.description: AI selloff vs everything-else rally, TSX record; gas gives back the 67-Bcf pop; Hormuz grinds tighter; referendum Monday.

item.title: Thu Oct 15 — Gas bid at three-week high into storage print
item.description: Nov Henry Hub ~$3.25 ahead of EIA (cons ~+77 vs +90 5-yr); NGTL linepack still ~1 Bcf under target; hot US CPI puts an October hike at a coin flip; Houthi attacks escalate, two ships sunk in Hormuz.

item.title: Wed Oct 14 — CPI day: inflation re-accelerating, Dec hike priced
item.description: Sept CPI at 6:30 MT (cons 3.6%); gas flat at $3.17 with AECO back at $1.24; stocks slip on mixed banks and memory chips; TTF at 45-month high; ATCO Yellowhead $3B pipeline; referendum Monday.

item.title: Tue Oct 13 — Gas fades as Gulf supply returns
item.description: Deep gas: two-day HH fade on Isaias restarts and soft feedgas; NGTL's first furnace pull; Saudi strikes Houthis; banks kick off earnings.

item.title: Mon Oct 12 — Riyadh attacked, crude bid, loaded week
item.description: Houthi strikes on Saudi airports kill 12 incl. an American; Brent 06; gas eases to .17 as Isaias fizzles for gas; banks Tue, US CPI Wed; referendum one week out. Happy Thanksgiving.

item.title: Fri Oct 9 — Isaias hits the Gulf; storage fades the gas rally
item.description: Hurricane Isaias shuts in two-thirds of Gulf oil; 85 Bcf injection cools the gas rally; AI trade's revenue fact-check; Canada jobs this morning.

item.title: Thu Oct 8 — Gas rallies fifth day as Isaias nears Gulf
item.description: Henry Hub at a two-week high; hurricane landfall Fri/Sat; EIA storage preview +79 Bcf; NGTL already withdrawing; Calgary's first snow Saturday.

item.title: Wed Oct 7 — Emera-ATCO mega-merger redraws Alberta utilities
item.description: Emera combines with Canadian Utilities/ATCO (2B) and Cenovus buys Athabasca (.7B); gas extends above ; S&P record as yields ease; Fed minutes today.

item.title: Tue Oct 6 — Records vs five percent yields
item.description: Nasdaq and Nvidia at records into 24-year-high yields; Brent settles 00.30 on G7 release; gas holds .07; Alberta referendums two weeks out.

item.title: Mon Oct 5 — Gas back above three dollars on first cool shot
item.description: Nov Henry Hub gaps above $3 as weekend models add Oct 12-15 cool shot; storage surplus narrows to 2.4%; OPEC+ holds; payrolls shock (+29K); Calgary snow by Saturday.

item.title: Fri Oct 2 — Jobs day; Pacific Link designated
item.description: US payrolls land mid-commute with the Fed at a coin flip; Ottawa names Pacific Link Canada's first national-interest project; gas at a one-week low after an on-consensus 64 Bcf build; oil drops 3% on stock-release talks.

item.title: Thu Oct 1 — Storage day, gas back below three dollars
item.description: Nov Henry Hub ~$2.96 ahead of EIA print (consensus +63 Bcf, FM-distorted week); MXP round trip complete; Carney pipeline decision today.

item.title: Wed Sep 30 — PCE day, quarter-end, US-Iran paper moving
item.description: PCE lands with Oct hike odds a coin flip; Tehran receives US Hormuz proposal, 40M-bbl SPR release; gas steady above $3; pipeline decision and fuel-tax holiday tomorrow.
